name: Sika® SealTape F
summary: Sika® SealTape F is an elastic system component which is used in combination with Sika®waterproofing products. It reduces the risk of leaks through potential cracking locations at wall corners, floor-to-wall connections, pipe entries etc.
metaDescription: Sika® SealTape F is an elastic system component which is used in combination with Sika<sup>®</sup>waterproofing products. It reduces the risk of leaks through potential cracking locations at wall corners, floor-to-wall connections, pipe entries etc.
attributes: Waterproof and watertight suitable for use in tiled pools and spas
Good adhesion to Sika® waterproofing products
usage: Crack-bridging and waterproofing tape used in combination with Sika
waterproofing products for reducing the risk of leakage at locations at risk to cracking for:
Cold storage areas, car washes and catering kitchens
Swimming pools and water retaining structures in combination with ceramic coverings
Sika® SealTape F can be used with the following suitable Sika waterproofing membranes
advantages: Waterproof and watertight suitable for use in tiled pools and spas
Good adhesion to Sika® waterproofing products

items.label: Composition
items.text:
Sealing layer | Thermoplastic elastomers (TPE)
Fleece | Non woven Polypropylene

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text: The product must be stored in original, unopened and undamaged packaging in dry conditions at temperatures between +5 °C and +30 °C. Always refer to packaging

items.label: Compatibility
items.text: Not suitable for direct contact with solvent based sealants or adhesives

items.label: Tensile strength
items.text:
Longitudinal | ≥ 85 N / 15 mm
Lateral | ≥ 15 N / 15 mm

items.label: Chemical resistance
items.text:
Chemically resistant against:
Caustic Potash 3%
Acetic Acid 5%
Lactic Acid 5%
Hydrochloric Acid 3%
Sulphuric Acid 35%
Citric Acid 10%
Sea Water 20g/l sea salt

items.label: Equivalent air layer thickness for water vapour
SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
items.text:
All substrates must be stable, clean, dry, free of any loose or friable particles, contaminants such as dust, dirt, oil, wax polish, grease, old adhesive residue, cement laitance or efflorescence. Smooth surfaces must be roughened lightly and dust removed to improve adhesion.
Surfaces shall be primed with a suitable primer prior to application. Refer to the selected Sika waterproofing membrane product data sheet for specific primer recomendations.
